Total distance \(= x+2x=3x\).  
Total time \(= \frac{x}{40}+\frac{x}{10}=\frac{x}{8}\).  
Average speed \(= \frac{3x}{x/8}=24\) km/h.

But the given average speed is \(48\) km/h, so \(48=24\), which is impossible. Thus no such journey exists.

\boxed{\text{No solution; the given data are inconsistent}}
